    <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
      const docScrollEl = document.scrollingElement || document.documentElement;

      // There can be multiple mega menus; support them all.
      document.querySelectorAll('.custom-mega-menu').forEach(function (menu) {
        const preview = menu.querySelector('#hover-preview');
        if (preview) {
          const defaultSrc = preview.getAttribute('src') || '';

          // Event delegation: react when a .category-link inside this menu is hovered
          menu.addEventListener('mouseover', function (ev) {
            const link = ev.target.closest('.category-link');
            if (!link || !menu.contains(link)) return;

            const img = link.getAttribute('data-img');
            if (!img) return;

            // Preload to avoid flicker
            const tmp = new Image();
            tmp.onload = function () {
              preview.style.opacity = 0;
              setTimeout(function () {
                preview.src = img;
                preview.style.opacity = 1;
              }, 120);
            };
            tmp.src = img;
          });

          // Optional: reset when leaving the menu
          menu.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () {
            if (defaultSrc) preview.src = defaultSrc;
          });
        }

      });

      const findScrollableContainer = function (element) {
        let current = element;
        while (current && current !== document.body) {
          if (current.classList && current.classList.contains('offcanvas-body')) {
            return current;
          }

          const styles = window.getComputedStyle(current);
          const overflowY = styles.overflowY;
          if (/(auto|scroll|overlay)/.test(overflowY)) {
            return current;
          }
          current = current.parentElement;
        }
        return docScrollEl;
      };

      const adjustScroll = function (container, delta) {
        if (Math.abs(delta) < 1) {
          return;
        }
        // Only counter upward motion
        if (delta >= 0) {
          return;
        }
        const adjustment = -delta;
        const target = container === document.body ? docScrollEl : container;
        target.scrollTop += adjustment;
      };

      const maintainAnchorDuringTransition = function (collapseEl, headerWrapper) {
        if (!headerWrapper) return;
        const header = headerWrapper.querySelector('.accordion-button');
        if (!header) return;

        const scrollContainer = findScrollableContainer(headerWrapper);
        const initialTop = header.getBoundingClientRect().top;
        let rafId = null;
        let active = true;

        const step = function () {
          if (!active) return;
          const newTop = header.getBoundingClientRect().top;
          adjustScroll(scrollContainer, newTop - initialTop);
          rafId = window.requestAnimationFrame(step);
        };

        const stop = function () {
          if (!active) return;
          active = false;
          if (rafId) {
            window.cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
            rafId = null;
          }
          const finalTop = header.getBoundingClientRect().top;
          adjustScroll(scrollContainer, finalTop - initialTop);
          collapseEl.removeEventListener('shown.bs.collapse', stop);
          collapseEl.removeEventListener('hidden.bs.collapse', stop);
        };

        rafId = window.requestAnimationFrame(step);
        collapseEl.addEventListener('shown.bs.collapse', stop);
        collapseEl.addEventListener('hidden.bs.collapse', stop);
      };

      // MOBILE: start collapsed (no auto-open)
      document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-category-accordion').forEach(function (accordion) {
        // No default 'show' applied; let Bootstrap start them collapsed.

        ['show.bs.collapse', 'hide.bs.collapse'].forEach(function (eventName) {
          accordion.addEventListener(eventName, function (event) {
            const collapseEl = event.target;
            if (!collapseEl.classList.contains('accordion-collapse')) {
              return;
            }
            maintainAnchorDuringTransition(collapseEl, collapseEl.previousElementSibling);
          });
        });
      });
    });
    </script>

    <style>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
      const docScrollEl = document.scrollingElement || document.documentElement;

      // There can be multiple mega menus; support them all.
      document.querySelectorAll('.custom-mega-menu').forEach(function (menu) {
        const preview = menu.querySelector('#hover-preview');
        if (preview) {
          const defaultSrc = preview.getAttribute('src') || '';

          // Event delegation: react when a .category-link inside this menu is hovered
          menu.addEventListener('mouseover', function (ev) {
            const link = ev.target.closest('.category-link');
            if (!link || !menu.contains(link)) return;

            const img = link.getAttribute('data-img');
            if (!img) return;

            // Preload to avoid flicker
            const tmp = new Image();
            tmp.onload = function () {
              preview.style.opacity = 0;
              setTimeout(function () {
                preview.src = img;
                preview.style.opacity = 1;
              }, 120);
            };
            tmp.src = img;
          });

          // Optional: reset when leaving the menu
          menu.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () {
            if (defaultSrc) preview.src = defaultSrc;
          });
        }

      });

      const findScrollableContainer = function (element) {
        let current = element;
        while (current && current !== document.body) {
          if (current.classList && current.classList.contains('offcanvas-body')) {
            return current;
          }

          const styles = window.getComputedStyle(current);
          const overflowY = styles.overflowY;
          if (/(auto|scroll|overlay)/.test(overflowY)) {
            return current;
          }
          current = current.parentElement;
        }
        return docScrollEl;
      };

      const adjustScroll = function (container, delta) {
        if (Math.abs(delta) < 1) {
          return;
        }
        // Only counter upward motion
        if (delta >= 0) {
          return;
        }
        const adjustment = -delta;
        const target = container === document.body ? docScrollEl : container;
        target.scrollTop += adjustment;
      };

      const maintainAnchorDuringTransition = function (collapseEl, headerWrapper) {
        if (!headerWrapper) return;
        const header = headerWrapper.querySelector('.accordion-button');
        if (!header) return;

        const scrollContainer = findScrollableContainer(headerWrapper);
        const initialTop = header.getBoundingClientRect().top;
        let rafId = null;
        let active = true;

        const step = function () {
          if (!active) return;
          const newTop = header.getBoundingClientRect().top;
          adjustScroll(scrollContainer, newTop - initialTop);
          rafId = window.requestAnimationFrame(step);
        };

        const stop = function () {
          if (!active) return;
          active = false;
          if (rafId) {
            window.cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
            rafId = null;
          }
          const finalTop = header.getBoundingClientRect().top;
          adjustScroll(scrollContainer, finalTop - initialTop);
          collapseEl.removeEventListener('shown.bs.collapse', stop);
          collapseEl.removeEventListener('hidden.bs.collapse', stop);
        };

        rafId = window.requestAnimationFrame(step);
        collapseEl.addEventListener('shown.bs.collapse', stop);
        collapseEl.addEventListener('hidden.bs.collapse', stop);
      };

      // MOBILE: start collapsed (no auto-open)
      document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-category-accordion').forEach(function (accordion) {
        // No default 'show' applied; let Bootstrap start them collapsed.

        ['show.bs.collapse', 'hide.bs.collapse'].forEach(function (eventName) {
          accordion.addEventListener(eventName, function (event) {
            const collapseEl = event.target;
            if (!collapseEl.classList.contains('accordion-collapse')) {
              return;
            }
            maintainAnchorDuringTransition(collapseEl, collapseEl.previousElementSibling);
          });
        });
      });
    });
    </script>
    <li role="presentation" class="nav-item">
        <a role="menuitem" href="/about-us" class="nav-link ">
            <span>ABOUT US</span>
        </a>
    </li>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
      const docScrollEl = document.scrollingElement || document.documentElement;

      // There can be multiple mega menus; support them all.
      document.querySelectorAll('.custom-mega-menu').forEach(function (menu) {
        const preview = menu.querySelector('#hover-preview');
        if (preview) {
          const defaultSrc = preview.getAttribute('src') || '';

          // Event delegation: react when a .category-link inside this menu is hovered
          menu.addEventListener('mouseover', function (ev) {
            const link = ev.target.closest('.category-link');
            if (!link || !menu.contains(link)) return;

            const img = link.getAttribute('data-img');
            if (!img) return;

            // Preload to avoid flicker
            const tmp = new Image();
            tmp.onload = function () {
              preview.style.opacity = 0;
              setTimeout(function () {
                preview.src = img;
                preview.style.opacity = 1;
              }, 120);
            };
            tmp.src = img;
          });

          // Optional: reset when leaving the menu
          menu.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () {
            if (defaultSrc) preview.src = defaultSrc;
          });
        }

      });

      const findScrollableContainer = function (element) {
        let current = element;
        while (current && current !== document.body) {
          if (current.classList && current.classList.contains('offcanvas-body')) {
            return current;
          }

          const styles = window.getComputedStyle(current);
          const overflowY = styles.overflowY;
          if (/(auto|scroll|overlay)/.test(overflowY)) {
            return current;
          }
          current = current.parentElement;
        }
        return docScrollEl;
      };

      const adjustScroll = function (container, delta) {
        if (Math.abs(delta) < 1) {
          return;
        }
        // Only counter upward motion
        if (delta >= 0) {
          return;
        }
        const adjustment = -delta;
        const target = container === document.body ? docScrollEl : container;
        target.scrollTop += adjustment;
      };

      const maintainAnchorDuringTransition = function (collapseEl, headerWrapper) {
        if (!headerWrapper) return;
        const header = headerWrapper.querySelector('.accordion-button');
        if (!header) return;

        const scrollContainer = findScrollableContainer(headerWrapper);
        const initialTop = header.getBoundingClientRect().top;
        let rafId = null;
        let active = true;

        const step = function () {
          if (!active) return;
          const newTop = header.getBoundingClientRect().top;
          adjustScroll(scrollContainer, newTop - initialTop);
          rafId = window.requestAnimationFrame(step);
        };

        const stop = function () {
          if (!active) return;
          active = false;
          if (rafId) {
            window.cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
            rafId = null;
          }
          const finalTop = header.getBoundingClientRect().top;
          adjustScroll(scrollContainer, finalTop - initialTop);
          collapseEl.removeEventListener('shown.bs.collapse', stop);
          collapseEl.removeEventListener('hidden.bs.collapse', stop);
        };

        rafId = window.requestAnimationFrame(step);
        collapseEl.addEventListener('shown.bs.collapse', stop);
        collapseEl.addEventListener('hidden.bs.collapse', stop);
      };

      // MOBILE: start collapsed (no auto-open)
      document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-category-accordion').forEach(function (accordion) {
        // No default 'show' applied; let Bootstrap start them collapsed.

        ['show.bs.collapse', 'hide.bs.collapse'].forEach(function (eventName) {
          accordion.addEventListener(eventName, function (event) {
            const collapseEl = event.target;
            if (!collapseEl.classList.contains('accordion-collapse')) {
              return;
            }
            maintainAnchorDuringTransition(collapseEl, collapseEl.previousElementSibling);
          });
        });
      });
    });
    </script>

          menu.addEventListener('mouseover', function (ev) {
            const link = ev.target.closest('.category-link');
            if (!link || !menu.contains(link)) return;

            const img = link.getAttribute('data-img');
            if (!img) return;

            // Preload to avoid flicker
            const tmp = new Image();
            tmp.onload = function () {
              preview.style.opacity = 0;
              setTimeout(function () {
                preview.src = img;
                preview.style.opacity = 1;
              }, 120);
            };
            tmp.src = img;
          });

          // Optional: reset when leaving the menu
          menu.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () {
            if (defaultSrc) preview.src = defaultSrc;
          });
        }

      });

      const findScrollableContainer = function (element) {
        let current = element;
        while (current && current !== document.body) {
          if (current.classList && current.classList.contains('offcanvas-body')) {
            return current;
          }

          const styles = window.getComputedStyle(current);
          const overflowY = styles.overflowY;
          if (/(auto|scroll|overlay)/.test(overflowY)) {
            return current;
          }
          current = current.parentElement;
        }
        return docScrollEl;
      };

      const adjustScroll = function (container, delta) {
        if (Math.abs(delta) < 1) {
          return;
        }
        // Only counter upward motion
        if (delta >= 0) {
          return;
        }
        const adjustment = -delta;
        const target = container === document.body ? docScrollEl : container;
        target.scrollTop += adjustment;
      };

      const maintainAnchorDuringTransition = function (collapseEl, headerWrapper) {
        if (!headerWrapper) return;
        const header = headerWrapper.querySelector('.accordion-button');
        if (!header) return;

        const scrollContainer = findScrollableContainer(headerWrapper);
        const initialTop = header.getBoundingClientRect().top;
        let rafId = null;
        let active = true;

        const step = function () {
          if (!active) return;
          const newTop = header.getBoundingClientRect().top;
          adjustScroll(scrollContainer, newTop - initialTop);
          rafId = window.requestAnimationFrame(step);
        };

        const stop = function () {
          if (!active) return;
          active = false;
          if (rafId) {
            window.cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
            rafId = null;
          }
          const finalTop = header.getBoundingClientRect().top;
          adjustScroll(scrollContainer, finalTop - initialTop);
          collapseEl.removeEventListener('shown.bs.collapse', stop);
          collapseEl.removeEventListener('hidden.bs.collapse', stop);
        };

        rafId = window.requestAnimationFrame(step);
        collapseEl.addEventListener('shown.bs.collapse', stop);
        collapseEl.addEventListener('hidden.bs.collapse', stop);
      };

      // MOBILE: start collapsed (no auto-open)
      document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-category-accordion').forEach(function (accordion) {
        // No default 'show' applied; let Bootstrap start them collapsed.

        ['show.bs.collapse', 'hide.bs.collapse'].forEach(function (eventName) {
          accordion.addEventListener(eventName, function (event) {
            const collapseEl = event.target;
            if (!collapseEl.classList.contains('accordion-collapse')) {
              return;
            }
            maintainAnchorDuringTransition(collapseEl, collapseEl.previousElementSibling);
          });
        });
      });
    });
    </script>

<script type="text/javascript">
(function () {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.matchMedia !== 'function') {
    window.matchMedia = function () {
      return {
        matches: false,
        media: '',
        addListener: function () {},
        removeListener: function () {},
        addEventListener: function () {},
        removeEventListener: function () {},
        dispatchEvent: function () { return false; }
      };
    };
  }

  if (typeof Element !== 'undefined' && !Element.prototype.matches) {
    Element.prototype.matches =
      Element.prototype.msMatchesSelector ||
      Element.prototype.webkitMatchesSelector ||
      function (selector) {
        const node = this;
        const doc = node && (node.document || node.ownerDocument);
        if (!doc || !doc.querySelectorAll) {
          return false;
        }
        const nodes = doc.querySelectorAll(selector);
        let i = 0;
        while (nodes[i] && nodes[i] !== node) {
          i++;
        }
        return Boolean(nodes[i]);
      };
  }

  const isElementNode = node => {
    if (!node) {
      return false;
    }
    if (typeof Node !== 'undefined' && node instanceof Node) {
      return node.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE;
    }
    return !!node.tagName;
  };

  const patchBootstrapCarousel = () => {
    const Carousel = window.bootstrap && window.bootstrap.Carousel;
    if (!Carousel || Carousel.__patchedSkipInvalidElements) {
      return;
    }

    const originalGetOrCreateInstance = Carousel.getOrCreateInstance;
    Carousel.getOrCreateInstance = function (element, ...args) {
      if (!isElementNode(element)) {
        return null;
      }
      return originalGetOrCreateInstance.call(this, element, ...args);
    };

    if (typeof Carousel.carouselInterface === 'function') {
      const originalCarouselInterface = Carousel.carouselInterface;
      Carousel.carouselInterface = function (config) {
        let context = this;
        if (context && typeof context.filter === 'function') {
          context = context.filter(function () {
            return isElementNode(this);
          });
        }
        if (!context || (context.length !== undefined && !context.length)) {
          return context;
        }
        return originalCarouselInterface.call(context, config);
      };
    }

    Carousel.__patchedSkipInvalidElements = true;
  };

  const patchjQueryCarousel = () => {
    if (!window.jQuery || !window.jQuery.fn || !window.jQuery.fn.carousel) {
      return;
    }
    const originalCarousel = window.jQuery.fn.carousel;
    if (originalCarousel.__patchedSkipInvalidElements) {
      return;
    }
    const patchedCarousel = function (...args) {
      const filtered = this.filter(function () {
        return isElementNode(this);
      });
      if (!filtered.length) {
        return filtered;
      }
      return originalCarousel.apply(filtered, args);
    };
    patchedCarousel.Constructor = originalCarousel.Constructor;
    if (typeof originalCarousel.noConflict === 'function') {
      patchedCarousel.noConflict = originalCarousel.noConflict.bind(originalCarousel);
    }
    patchedCarousel.__patchedSkipInvalidElements = true;
    window.jQuery.fn.carousel = patchedCarousel;
  };

  // ✅ CHANGED HERE: compensateScrollbar patch (do NOT pass window to original plugin)
  const patchCompensateScrollbar = () => {
    const $ = window.jQuery;
    if (!$ || !$.fn || !$.fn.compensateScrollbar) {
      return;
    }
    const originalFn = $.fn.compensateScrollbar;
    if (originalFn.__patchedSkipInvalidElements) {
      return;
    }

    const safeMakeJq = elements => {
      try {
        return $(elements);
      } catch (e) {
        return $();
      }
    };

    const patchedFn = function (...args) {
      // Build a clean list of real DOM elements (and allow window).
      const elements = [];
      const raw = this && this.toArray ? this.toArray() : [];
      for (let i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
        const el = raw[i];
        if (el === window) {
          elements.push(el);
          continue;
        }
        if (isElementNode(el)) {
          elements.push(el);
        }
      }
      const filtered = safeMakeJq(elements);
      if (!filtered.length) {
        return filtered;
      }
      try {
        return originalFn.apply(filtered, args);
      } catch (err) {
        // Last-resort guard: don't break the page if a theme/module passes invalid nodes.
        console.warn("compensateScrollbar guarded error:", err);
        return filtered;
      }
    };

    patchedFn.__patchedSkipInvalidElements = true;
    $.fn.compensateScrollbar = patchedFn;
  };

    safeFn.__cmPatchedNoThrow = true;
    safeFn.__cmOriginal = originalFn;
    window.jQuery.fn.compensateScrollbar = safeFn;
  };

    patchedFn.__patchedSkipInvalidElements = true;
    window.jQuery.fn.compensateScrollbar = patchedFn;
  };

  const applyPatches = () => {
    patchBootstrapCarousel();
    patchjQueryCarousel();
    patchCompensateScrollbar();
  };

  let patchAttempts = 0;
  const maxPatchAttempts = 20;

  const ensurePatched = () => {
    applyPatches();
    if (window.bootstrap && window.bootstrap.Carousel && window.bootstrap.Carousel.__patchedSkipInvalidElements) {
      return;
    }
    patchAttempts += 1;
    if (patchAttempts >= maxPatchAttempts) {
      return;
    }
    window.setTimeout(ensurePatched, 200);
  };

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', ensurePatched, { once: true });
  } else {
    ensurePatched();
  }
})();
</script>

            <script>
                (function () {
                    const WRAP_SELECTOR = '.o_product_indicator_wrap';

                    const EASE = (t) => t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;

                    function smoothScrollTo(el, target, duration = 320) {
                        const start = el.scrollLeft;
                        const dist = target - start;
                        if (!dist || duration <= 0) {
                            el.scrollLeft = target;
                            return;
                        }
                        let t0;
                        const step = (ts) => {
                            if (!t0) {
                                t0 = ts;
                            }
                            const p = Math.min(1, (ts - t0) / duration);
                            el.scrollLeft = start + dist * EASE(p);
                            if (p < 1) {
                                requestAnimationFrame(step);
                            }
                        };
                        requestAnimationFrame(step);
                    }

                    function kineticScroll(el, velocity) {
                        const max = Math.max(0, el.scrollWidth - el.clientWidth);
                        let prev = performance.now();
                        let v = velocity;
                        const minV = 0.02;
                        const friction = 0.94;

                        function step(ts) {
                            const dt = ts - prev;
                            prev = ts;
                            const decay = Math.pow(friction, dt / 16);
                            v *= decay;
                            if (Math.abs(v) < minV) {
                                return;
                            }

                            let next = el.scrollLeft + v * dt;
                            if (next < 0) {
                                next = 0;
                                v = 0;
                            }
                            if (next > max) {
                                next = max;
                                v = 0;
                            }

                            el.scrollLeft = next;
                            if (v !== 0) {
                                requestAnimationFrame(step);
                            }
                        }

                        requestAnimationFrame(step);
                    }

                    function measureItem(track) {
                        const first = track.querySelector('.o_product_indicator_item');
                        if (!first) {
                            return 0;
                        }
                        const rect = first.getBoundingClientRect();
                        const styles = window.getComputedStyle(first);
                        return rect.width + parseFloat(styles.marginLeft || 0) + parseFloat(styles.marginRight || 0);
                    }

                    function initWrap(wrap) {
                        if (wrap.dataset.sliderInit) {
                            return;
                        }
                        wrap.dataset.sliderInit = '1';

                        const slider = wrap.querySelector('.o_product_indicator_slider');
                        const track = wrap.querySelector('.o_product_indicator_track');
                        const prevBtn = wrap.querySelector('.o_product_indicator_arrow--prev');
                        const nextBtn = wrap.querySelector('.o_product_indicator_arrow--next');

                        if (!slider || !track) {
                            return;
                        }

                        const updateArrows = () => {
                            const max = Math.max(0, slider.scrollWidth - slider.clientWidth);
                            const hasOverflow = slider.scrollWidth > slider.clientWidth + 4;
                            const atStart = slider.scrollLeft <= 1;
                            const atEnd = slider.scrollLeft >= (max - 1);

                            if (prevBtn) {
                                prevBtn.hidden = !hasOverflow || atStart;
                                prevBtn.disabled = atStart;
                            }
                            if (nextBtn) {
                                nextBtn.hidden = !hasOverflow || atEnd;
                                nextBtn.disabled = atEnd;
                            }
                        };

                        const PAGE = () => {
                            const itemSize = measureItem(track) || slider.clientWidth / 3;
                            return itemSize * 3;
                        };

                        prevBtn && prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                            smoothScrollTo(slider, Math.max(0, slider.scrollLeft - PAGE()), 320);
                        });

                        nextBtn && nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                            const max = slider.scrollWidth - slider.clientWidth;
                            smoothScrollTo(slider, Math.min(max, slider.scrollLeft + PAGE()), 320);
                        });

                        let isDown = false;
                        let startX = 0;
                        let startScroll = 0;
                        let moved = false;
                        let lastX = 0;
                        let lastT = 0;
                        let vx = 0;

                        const start = (clientX) => {
                            isDown = true;
                            moved = false;
                            vx = 0;
                            slider.classList.add('is-dragging');
                            const rect = slider.getBoundingClientRect();
                            startX = clientX - rect.left;
                            startScroll = slider.scrollLeft;
                            lastX = clientX;
                            lastT = performance.now();
                        };

                        const move = (clientX) => {
                            if (!isDown) {
                                return;
                            }
                            const rect = slider.getBoundingClientRect();
                            const x = clientX - rect.left;
                            const walk = x - startX;
                            if (Math.abs(walk) > 3) {
                                moved = true;
                            }

                            const now = performance.now();
                            const dt = now - lastT || 1;
                            vx = (clientX - lastX) / dt;
                            lastX = clientX;
                            lastT = now;

                            slider.scrollLeft = startScroll - walk;
                            updateArrows();
                        };

                        const end = () => {
                            if (!isDown) {
                                return;
                            }
                            isDown = false;
                            slider.classList.remove('is-dragging');
                            const vScroll = -vx;
                            kineticScroll(slider, vScroll);
                        };

                        slider.addEventListener('mousedown', (ev) => {
                            if (ev.button !== 0) {
                                return;
                            }
                            start(ev.clientX);
                            ev.preventDefault();
                        });

                        window.addEventListener('mousemove', (ev) => move(ev.clientX));
                        window.addEventListener('mouseup', end);
                        slider.addEventListener('mouseleave', end);

                        slider.addEventListener('touchstart', (ev) => {
                            const touch = ev.touches[0];
                            if (!touch) {
                                return;
                            }
                            start(touch.clientX);
                        }, { passive: true });

                        slider.addEventListener('touchmove', (ev) => {
                            const touch = ev.touches[0];
                            if (!touch) {
                                return;
                            }
                            move(touch.clientX);
                        }, { passive: true });

                        slider.addEventListener('touchend', end);

                        slider.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
                            if (moved) {
                                ev.preventDefault();
                                ev.stopPropagation();
                            }
                        }, true);

                        slider.addEventListener('scroll', updateArrows, { passive: true });
                        new ResizeObserver(updateArrows).observe(slider);
                        updateArrows();
                    }

                    const initAll = () => {
                        document.querySelectorAll(WRAP_SELECTOR).forEach(initWrap);
                    };

                    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
                        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initAll, { once: true });
                    } else {
                        initAll();
                    }

                    document.addEventListener('product_variant_change', initAll);
                })();
            </script>
        </div>
                        </div>

                I confirm that I authorize the use of the data sent, according to the <a data-bs-original-title="" title="" href="/privacy-policy">Privacy Policy</a>

<script>
(function () {
  const escapeHtml = value => {
    if (typeof value !== "string") {
      return "";
    }
    const helper = document.createElement("div");
    helper.textContent = value;
    return helper.innerHTML;
  };

  function enhanceEmailBody(modalEl) {
    if (!modalEl) {
      return;
    }
    const forms = modalEl.querySelectorAll('form[data-role="product-popup-form"]');
    forms.forEach(form => {
      const bodyField = form.querySelector('[name="body_html"]');
      if (!bodyField) {
        return;
      }
      const messageField = form.querySelector('textarea[name="Message"]');
      const productField = form.querySelector('input[name="Product Name"]');

      const buildBody = () => {
        const productNameRaw = (form.dataset.productName || (productField && productField.value) || '').trim();
        const productUrlRaw = (form.dataset.productUrl || '').trim();
        const messageRaw = messageField && messageField.value ? messageField.value.trim() : '';
        const bodyParts = [];
        if (productNameRaw) {
          const safeProductName = escapeHtml(productNameRaw);
          const safeProductUrl = escapeHtml(productUrlRaw);
          bodyParts.push(`<p><strong>Product:</strong> ${safeProductName}</p>`);
          if (productUrlRaw) {
            bodyParts.push(`<p><a href="/shop/${safeProductUrl}">${safeProductUrl}</a></p>`);
          }
        }
        if (messageRaw) {
          const safeMessage = escapeHtml(messageRaw).replace(/\r?\n/g, '<br/>');
          bodyParts.push(`<p>${safeMessage}</p>`);
        }
        bodyField.value = bodyParts.join('') || '';
      };

      form.addEventListener('submit', buildBody);
      if (messageField) {
        messageField.addEventListener('input', buildBody);
        messageField.addEventListener('change', buildBody);
      }
      buildBody();
    });
  }

  function setupProductPopup(options) {
    const modalEl = document.getElementById(options.modalId);
    if (!modalEl) {
      return;
    }

    enhanceEmailBody(modalEl);

    const conditionalRequiredContainers = Array.from(modalEl.querySelectorAll('[data-required-if-visible]'));

    const isElementVisible = element => {
      if (!element) {
        return false;
      }
      if (element.closest('.d-none')) {
        return false;
      }
      let current = element;
      while (current && current !== document.body) {
        if (current.classList && current.classList.contains('d-none')) {
          return false;
        }
        const style = window.getComputedStyle(current);
        if (style.display === 'none' || style.visibility === 'hidden') {
          return false;
        }
        current = current.parentElement;
      }
      return true;
    };

    const updateConditionalRequired = () => {
      conditionalRequiredContainers.forEach(container => {
        const field = container.matches('input, select, textarea')
          ? container
          : container.querySelector('input, select, textarea');
        if (!field) {
          return;
        }
        const marker = container.querySelector('[data-role="required-marker"]');
        if (isElementVisible(container)) {
          field.setAttribute('required', 'required');
          field.setAttribute('aria-required', 'true');
          container.classList.add('s_website_form_required');
          if (marker) {
            marker.classList.remove('d-none');
          }
        } else {
          field.removeAttribute('required');
          field.removeAttribute('aria-required');
          container.classList.remove('s_website_form_required');
          if (marker) {
            marker.classList.add('d-none');
          }
        }
      });
    };

    if (conditionalRequiredContainers.length) {
      window.setTimeout(updateConditionalRequired, 0);
      const visibilityControls = modalEl.querySelectorAll('input, select');
      visibilityControls.forEach(control => {
        control.addEventListener('change', () => window.setTimeout(updateConditionalRequired, 0));
      });
      modalEl.addEventListener('o_website_form_update_visibility', () => window.setTimeout(updateConditionalRequired, 0));
      const mutationObserver = new MutationObserver(() => window.setTimeout(updateConditionalRequired, 0));
      conditionalRequiredContainers.forEach(container => {
        mutationObserver.observe(container, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class', 'style'] });
      });
    }

    const form = modalEl.querySelector("form.o_mark_required");
    const successTarget = modalEl.querySelector(options.successSelector || "[data-role=\"form-result\"]");
    const thanksContainer = modalEl.querySelector("[data-role=\"thanks-container\"]");
    const thanksTemplate = modalEl.querySelector("[data-role=\"thanks-template\"]");
    const privacyNotices = Array.from(modalEl.querySelectorAll("[data-role=\"privacy-notice\"]"));
    const originalResultClass = successTarget ? successTarget.getAttribute("class") || "" : "";
    const initDelay = typeof options.initDelay === "number" ? options.initDelay : 300;
    let hasShownThanks = false;
    let successAlertObserver = null;

    const hasActiveErrors = () => {
      if (!modalEl) {
        return false;
      }
      const errorSelectors = options.errorSelectors || [
        ".o_has_error",
        ".o_invalid_field",
        ".is-invalid",
        ".invalid-feedback:not(.d-none)",
        ".alert.alert-danger:not(.d-none)",
        "[data-role=\"form-result\"].alert-danger",
        "[data-role=\"form-result\"] .alert-danger"
      ];
      const hasSelectorErrors = errorSelectors.some(selector => modalEl.querySelector(selector));
      if (hasSelectorErrors) {
        return true;
      }
      if (form && (form.classList.contains("o_has_error") || form.classList.contains("s_website_form_has_error"))) {
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    };

    const showThanks = () => {
      if (!form || !thanksContainer || !thanksTemplate || hasShownThanks) {
        return;
      }
      hasShownThanks = true;
      form.classList.add("d-none");
      thanksContainer.innerHTML = thanksTemplate.innerHTML;
      thanksContainer.classList.remove("d-none");
      if (successAlertObserver) {
        successAlertObserver.disconnect();
        successAlertObserver = null;
      }
      privacyNotices.forEach(node => node.classList.add("d-none"));
    };

    const handleSuccess = () => {
      if (hasShownThanks) {
        return;
      }
      if (successTarget) {
        successTarget.innerHTML = "";
        successTarget.setAttribute("class", originalResultClass);
      }
      modalEl.querySelectorAll(".alert.alert-success").forEach(node => node.remove());
      showThanks();
    };

    const observeSuccessAlerts = () => {
      if (successAlertObserver) {
        successAlertObserver.disconnect();
      }
      successAlertObserver = new MutationObserver(mutations => {
        if (hasShownThanks) {
          return;
        }
        const hasSuccess = mutations.some(mutation =>
          Array.from(mutation.addedNodes || []).some(node => {
            if (node.nodeType !== Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
              return false;
            }
            if (node.classList && node.classList.contains("alert") && node.classList.contains("alert-success")) {
              return true;
            }
            return !!(node.querySelector && node.querySelector(".alert.alert-success"));
          })
        );
        if (hasSuccess) {
          handleSuccess();
        }
      });
      successAlertObserver.observe(modalEl, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    };

    const resetPopupState = () => {
      if (form) {
        form.classList.remove("d-none");
        form.reset();
      }
      hasShownThanks = false;
      if (conditionalRequiredContainers.length) {
        window.setTimeout(updateConditionalRequired, 0);
      }
      if (thanksContainer) {
        thanksContainer.innerHTML = "";
        thanksContainer.classList.add("d-none");
      }
      if (successTarget) {
        successTarget.innerHTML = "";
        successTarget.setAttribute("class", originalResultClass);
      }
      modalEl.querySelectorAll(".alert.alert-success").forEach(node => node.remove());
      privacyNotices.forEach(node => node.classList.remove("d-none"));
      observeSuccessAlerts();
    };

    if (form) {
      if (window.jQuery) {
        const $form = window.jQuery(form);
        $form.on("o_website_form_success", handleSuccess);
        $form.on("o_website_form_submit", () => {
          if (thanksContainer) {
            thanksContainer.innerHTML = "";
            thanksContainer.classList.add("d-none");
          }
          privacyNotices.forEach(node => node.classList.remove("d-none"));
          form.classList.remove("d-none");
        });
      }

      form.addEventListener("o_website_form_success", handleSuccess, true);
      form.addEventListener("o_website_form_submit", () => {
        if (thanksContainer) {
          thanksContainer.innerHTML = "";
          thanksContainer.classList.add("d-none");
        }
        privacyNotices.forEach(node => node.classList.remove("d-none"));
        form.classList.remove("d-none");
      });

      const submitButtons = modalEl.querySelectorAll(options.submitButtonSelector || ".s_website_form_send");
      const submitCheckDelay = typeof options.submitCheckDelay === "number" ? options.submitCheckDelay : 300;
      submitButtons.forEach(button => {
        button.addEventListener("click", () => {
          window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (!hasActiveErrors()) {
              handleSuccess();
            }
          }, submitCheckDelay);
        });
      });
    }

    if (successTarget) {
      const resultObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
        if (hasShownThanks) {
          return;
        }
        const hasMessage = successTarget.textContent && successTarget.textContent.trim().length > 0;
        const hasSuccessAlert = !!(successTarget.querySelector && successTarget.querySelector(".alert.alert-success"));
        if (hasMessage || hasSuccessAlert) {
          handleSuccess();
        }
      });
      resultObserver.observe(successTarget, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }

    modalEl.addEventListener("show.bs.modal", () => {
      resetPopupState();
    });

    modalEl.addEventListener("shown.bs.modal", () => {
      window.setTimeout(() => {
        try {
          if (window.odoo?.website?.website_form?.init) {
            window.odoo.website.website_form.init();
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("Error initializing website_form in modal:", err);
        }
      }, initDelay);
      if (conditionalRequiredContainers.length) {
        window.setTimeout(updateConditionalRequired, initDelay);
      }
    });

    modalEl.addEventListener("hidden.bs.modal", () => {
      resetPopupState();
    });

    if (options.openButtonSelector) {
      const showModal = () => {
        if (typeof bootstrap !== "undefined" && bootstrap.Modal) {
          const modalInstance = bootstrap.Modal.getOrCreateInstance(modalEl);
          modalInstance.show();
          return true;
        }
        if (window.jQuery && typeof window.jQuery(modalEl).modal === "function") {
          window.jQuery(modalEl).modal("show");
          return true;
        }
        return false;
      };

      document.querySelectorAll(options.openButtonSelector).forEach(trigger => {
        trigger.addEventListener("click", event => {
          event.preventDefault();
          if (!showModal()) {
            console.warn("Modal dependencies missing for", options.modalId);
          }
        });
      });
    }

    observeSuccessAlerts();
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    const popups = [
      { modalId: "infoRequestModal", openButtonSelector: "#openFormBtn", initDelay: 300 },
      { modalId: "requestCustomizationModal", initDelay: 300 },
      { modalId: "modal3DForm", initDelay: 600 }
    ];
    popups.forEach(setupProductPopup);
  });
})();
</script>

                <form action="/website/form/" method="post" enctype="multipart/form-data" class="o_mark_required" data-mark="*" data-pre-fill="true" data-model_name="mail.mail" data-success-mode="message" data-role="product-popup-form" data-product-name="BALANCE" data-product-url="https://www.casamagna.eu/shop/balance-sofa-w250-new-1779">
                  <div class="s_website_form_rows row s_col_no_bgcolor">
                    <div data-name="Field" class="s_website_form_field mb-3 col-12 col-lg-12 s_website_form_custom" data-type="selection">
                    <label class="s_website_form_label d-none" style="width: 200px" for="opmobjbten2"><span class="s_website_form_label_content">Type</span></label>                      
                      <div class="row s_col_no_resize s_col_no_bgcolor s_website_form_multiple" data-name="Client Type" data-display="horizontal">
                        <div class="radio col-12 col-lg-4 col-md-6">
                          <div class="form-check">
                            <input type="radio" class="s_website_form_input form-check-input" id="opmobjbten20_custom" name="Client Type" value="Professional" data-fill-with="undefined"/>
                            <label class="form-check-label s_website_form_check_label" for="opmobjbten20_custom">Professional</label>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="radio col-12 col-lg-4 col-md-6">
                          <div class="form-check">
                            <input type="radio" class="s_website_form_input form-check-input" id="opmobjbten21_custom" name="Client Type" value="Private Client"/>
                            <label class="form-check-label s_website_form_check_label" for="opmobjbten21_custom">Private Client</label>
                          </div>

                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div data-name="Field" class="s_website_form_field mb-3 col-12 s_website_form_custom s_website_form_required col-lg-6" data-type="char">
                      <div class="row s_col_no_resize s_col_no_bgcolor">
                        <label class="col-form-label col-sm-auto s_website_form_label" style="width: 200px" for="oa5legxki24_custom"><span class="s_website_form_label_content">First Name</span><span class="s_website_form_mark"> *</span></label>
                        <div class="col-sm">
                          <input class="form-control s_website_form_input" type="text" name="First Name" required="1" placeholder="" id="oa5legxki24_custom" data-fill-with="name"/>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div data-name="Field" class="s_website_form_field mb-3 col-12 s_website_form_custom s_website_form_required col-lg-6" data-type="char">
                      <div class="row s_col_no_resize s_col_no_bgcolor">
                        <label class="col-form-label col-sm-auto s_website_form_label" style="width: 200px" for="oyuyiohoxen_custom"><span class="s_website_form_label_content">Last Name</span><span class="s_website_form_mark"> *</span></label>
                        <div class="col-sm">
                          <input class="form-control s_website_form_input" type="text" name="Last Name" placeholder="" id="oyuyiohoxen_custom" data-fill-with="undefined" required=""/>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div data-name="Field" class="s_website_form_field mb-3 col-12 s_website_form_model_required" data-type="email">
                      <div class="row s_col_no_resize s_col_no_bgcolor">
